capabilities: Create mind map files from markdown notes in basic and rich modes
Display mind maps as outlines or tables
Add summaries, boundaries, related links and free nodes in rich mode
Annotate PDFs with highlights and rectangles and relate them to mind map nodes
Export mind maps to HTML, images and PDF
extras: Freemium: PDF annotation and PDF export are Catalyst ($16 one-time) features, with a 30-day free trial. PDF annotation only supports Obsidian 1.4 via PDF++; on Obsidian 1.5+ the README directs users to the separate closed-source Markmind desktop software.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view and edit notes as visual mind maps, or to tie PDF annotations to mind map nodes.

relations.evidence: It works similar to the obsidian-enhancing-MindMap plugin

summary: Freemium plugin that renders markdown notes as mind maps with outline and table modes, and annotates PDFs linked to mind map nodes.
